meta.title: Agni AI App Studio
meta.description: Agni runs open AI models on your own computer: one click to install, checked against your hardware, private by design.
meta.ogTitle: Agni AI App Studio: your AI, one click away
hero.title: Your AI, one click away.
hero.lede: Agni runs open AI models on your own computer. Browse a curated store, see at a glance which models your machine can handle, and start chatting. No terminal, no Python, no setup.
hero.note: For Windows, macOS and Linux. Free to run models on your own computer.
mock.label: Agni's store showing three models: Qwen 2.5 Mini runs great, Mistral 7B runs but slower, a 70-billion-parameter model won't run on this computer.
mock.llama: Needs about 48 GB of memory · 42 GB
why.title: Everything hard about local AI, handled for you.
why.lede: Running AI on your own machine usually means command lines, drivers and guesswork. Agni turns it into something that feels like an app store.
why.private.title: Private by design
why.private.text: Models run on your computer. Your questions, documents and answers never leave it, so it works for personal and confidential material.
why.hardware.title: Checked against your hardware
why.hardware.text: Agni scans your computer and marks every model green, amber or red before you download, so you never wait for gigabytes that won't run.
why.oneClick.title: One click to install
why.oneClick.text: Pick a model, press Install, watch the progress bar. Agni downloads it, checks it and sets it up. No terminal, Python or drivers to manage.
why.license.title: License-checked
why.license.text: Every model in the store shows its license in plain words, so you know whether you can use it for work before you rely on it.
why.free.title: Free on your computer
why.free.text: Running models on your own machine is free, for good, with no account needed. You only pay if you want the extra connectors in Agni Plus.
why.chatApp.title: Your choice of chat app
why.chatApp.text: Chat inside Agni, or install a different chat window, such as Hollama or AnythingLLM, from the Apps & Extensions tab. They all use the models you installed.
how.title: From download to first answer in minutes.
how.open.title: Open Agni
how.open.text: Agni checks your computer's memory, graphics card and free space, and sets up the engine that runs models.
how.pick.title: Pick a green model
how.pick.text: Browse by what you want to do: chat, writing, coding. Green means it runs great on your machine. Press Install.
how.chat.title: Start chatting
how.chat.text: Ask anything, right away, with nothing sent over the internet. Remove a model in one click when you're done with it.
fit.title: Know before you download.
fit.lede: AI models range from 1 GB to over 100 GB, and the wrong one can freeze an ordinary laptop. Agni compares what each model needs with what your computer has, and tells you in plain words.
fit.greatText: Fits comfortably in your memory or graphics card. Replies come quickly.
fit.okText: It works, with replies taking a little longer. Fine for occasional use.
fit.okSpec: e.g. a 7B model, no graphics card
fit.noText: Needs more memory or disk space than you have. Agni won't let you download it by mistake.

compare.installAgni: One click, with a progress bar
compare.run: Will it run on my computer?
compare.runDiy: Find out after a multi-gigabyte download
compare.work: Can I use it for work?

compare.toolsAgni: Add a connector in one click

sources.title: Downloaded from the people who publish the models.
sources.lede: Agni doesn't host copies. Each model downloads directly from Hugging Face or ModelScope, the libraries where AI labs publish their work. Before anything is installed, Agni checks that the file matches the publisher's digital fingerprint exactly.
images.title: Describe it, and see it made.
images.lede: Agni can also create pictures from a short description, entirely on your computer. Install an image model the same way as a chat model, type what you want to see, and save the result. Nothing you describe is sent anywhere.
images.zimage: Detailed, realistic pictures in a few steps, from Alibaba's Tongyi Lab. Apache 2.0 license, fine for work.
images.sd: The classic open image model. Small and quick, so it suits older computers. Its license lists a few uses it doesn't allow.
images.private: Your descriptions and pictures stay on your computer. No account, no credits, no limit on how many you make.
connectors.title: Let your AI get things done.
connectors.lede: Connectors give your models tools. With one click, a model can work with your files, read your documents, look up a web page or remember what matters to you, all from a chat on your own computer.
connectors.files.title: Files
connectors.files.text: Reads, searches and organises files, only inside the folders you choose.
connectors.web.title: Web pages
connectors.web.text: Opens a page you point it to, so your model can summarise articles, docs and news.
connectors.time.title: Date & time
connectors.time.text: Knows today's date and the time anywhere, and converts between time zones.
connectors.documents.title: Documents
connectors.documents.text: Reads PDFs, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, so you can ask questions about them.
connectors.memory.title: Memory
connectors.memory.text: Remembers people, projects and preferences across chats. Stored only on your computer.
connectors.git.text: Looks through a code project's history and changes, and commits when you allow it.
connectors.callout: You stay in charge. Anything that would change your files waits for your OK first, and every step the model takes is shown in the chat. Remove a connector in one click. More connectors are on the way.
pricing.title: Free to run. Plus when you want more.
pricing.lede: Everything you need to run AI on your own computer is free. Agni Plus adds more connectors, so your models can do more of the work for you.

faq.title: Good to know.
faq.free.a: Yes. Browsing the store, installing models, chatting, creating images and the basic connectors are free, for good, with no account needed. Agni Plus is an optional subscription that adds more connectors.
faq.plus.q: What do I get with Agni Plus?
faq.plus.a: Every connector, including Documents, Memory and Git, plus each new connector and automation as it's added. Your models and chats work the same either way; Plus gives them more tools.
faq.upgrade.q: How do I upgrade, or cancel?
faq.upgrade.a: In Agni, click Sign in at the top and sign in with a code sent to your email. Choose a plan, and pay on Stripe's secure checkout page. To change your card or cancel, open Manage subscription in the same place. If you cancel, Plus stays on until the end of the period you paid for.
faq.hardware.q: Do I need a powerful computer or a graphics card?
faq.hardware.a: No. Small models run well on an ordinary laptop with 8 GB of memory. A graphics card or an Apple silicon Mac makes bigger models faster, and Agni's hardware check shows you exactly what your machine can handle.
faq.internet.q: Does anything I type get sent to the internet?
faq.internet.a: No. Once a model is installed, your conversations happen entirely on your computer. Agni only goes online to download models and connectors, to update its store, and, if you sign in, to check your plan. The Web pages connector is the exception you choose: when you ask about a page, it fetches that page.
faq.models.q: Where do the models come from?
faq.models.a: From Hugging Face and ModelScope, where AI labs such as Alibaba, Meta, Microsoft and Mistral publish them. Agni downloads them directly from there and verifies every file.
faq.business.q: Can I use these models for my business?
faq.business.a: Many of them, yes. Each model in the store shows its license and whether commercial use is allowed, allowed with conditions, or not allowed, so you can choose with confidence.
faq.languages.a: The app is in English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, German, Arabic and Hindi, and picks your computer's language automatically. The AI models themselves reply in whatever language you write in.
